description:
Ori is a local operations CLI for the openclaw-a2a-server (the launchd-managed
A2A protocol bridge running on localhost:8788). It replaces the per-agent MCP
tool sprawl from mcp-a2a-bridge (`chat_ori`, `chat_adam`, `resume_ori`, ...)
with one cohesive CLI that has:

- A local SQLite mirror of task history with FTS5 search across past
  conversations and accumulated agent responses.
- One verb per operation across all agents (`ori chat ori "..."`,
  `ori tasks list --agent adam --since 24h`).
- A `doctor` command that bundles the recurring openclaw-stack diagnostics
  (launchd bridge alive, A2A server reachable on :8788, agent cards
  discoverable, plugin cache env vars commented in compose).
- A `kickstart` command for the post-`compose-down/up` ritual that otherwise
  requires remembering the `launchctl kickstart -k
  gui/$(id -u)/dev.error2.openclaw-a2a-server` incantation.

Backend is the A2A JSON-RPC server on :8788. This OpenAPI document re-shapes
that JSON-RPC surface into REST-style resources so the generated CLI has
natural verb-noun ergonomics — the generated client package translates
REST calls into the underlying JSON-RPC dispatch (SendMessage, GetTask,
ListTasks, CancelTask, SubscribeToTask).

No authentication required by default — the A2A server is loopback-only.
Bearer auth (A2A_AUTH_TOKEN_FILE) is supported but not the standard local
config.

tools.name: a2a_approvals_list
tools.description: Lists approval requests this agent has emitted that are still waiting on a user decision. Returns the approval id, a human summary, requested_at timestamp, and any context payload the agent attached. Required: agent.

tools.name: a2a_approvals_respond
tools.description: Approve or deny a pending approval. Optional `reason` is passed back to the agent verbatim. Required: agent, approval_id, decision. Optional: reason. Returns the new ApprovalsRespondResponse.

params.name: reason
params.description: Optional rationale shown to the agent

tools.name: a2a_tasks_cancel
tools.description: Wraps the A2A JSON-RPC `CancelTask` method. Idempotent on already-terminal tasks (returns the terminal state). Use this when an agent is wedged and you want to free up its slot without restarting the bridge. Required: agent, task_id. Destructive.

tools.name: a2a_tasks_get
tools.description: Wraps the A2A JSON-RPC `GetTask` method. Returns current state and accumulated text for a specific task. Useful for polling when `sendMessage` was called with `wait: false`. Required: agent, task_id. Optional: context_id.

tools.name: a2a_tasks_list
tools.description: Wraps the A2A JSON-RPC `ListTasks` method. Returns all tasks the agent knows about (in-flight + recently terminal). For long-running ops, this is the source of truth for 'what is ori actually doing right now'. Required: agent. Optional: context_id, page_size (default: 50), page_token.

params.name: context_id
params.description: Filter to a single conversation context

tools.name: a2a_tasks_resume
tools.description: Fetches the current state + accumulated artifacts of an existing task by id (snapshot, not a stream). Useful after a dispatch returned a transport-level `failed` to discover whether the work actually completed server-side. Internally a thin alias for GetTask; for wait-until-terminal semantics, poll this or use send-message with wait=true. Required: agent, task_id. Returns the Task.

tools.name: a2a_tasks_send-message
tools.description: Wraps the A2A JSON-RPC `SendMessage` method. Streams chunks back via SSE if the agent advertises `streaming: true` in its card; the CLI client will accumulate text and return on terminal state. Required: agent, message. Optional: context_id, wait (default: true). Returns the new Task.

params.name: context_id
params.description: Optional context id. Provide to continue an existing conversation; omit to start a new context.

params.name: message
params.description: Message text to send to the agent

params.name: wait
params.description: If true (default), wait for the task to reach a terminal state and return accumulated text. If false, return immediately with the initial task id; poll via GET /a2a/{agent}/tasks/{task_id}.

tools.name: healthz_health
tools.description: Returns 200 with `{ok: true}` when the launchd-managed a2a-server is responding. The most common failure mode is the bridge being wedged after a `compose down/up` — in that case, `ori service kickstart` (a hand-built compound command, not in this spec) re-runs the `launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/dev.error2.openclaw-a2a-server` recovery.

tools.name: well-known_list-agents
tools.description: Returns the agent name list configured via OPENCLAW_AGENTS_CONFIG (~/.openclaw/agents.toml). Typically returns ['ori', 'adam'].

tools.name: well-known_agent-card-json_get-agent
tools.description: Returns the full A2A agent card including capabilities flags (streaming, input_required, push_notifications, approvals). Use this to discover whether an agent supports a particular feature before invoking it. Required: agent.
